fields.why: Prevalence, PRs and AAPCs are reported per race and per age group and compared (white and Hispanic higher than black among <20; highest prevalence at <20), with no test across the groups.
Three race groups within age, three (figure: five) ordered age groups, and the nine race x age strata ranked by AAPC ('two highest AAPCs among these strata'), which rule 3 lets count as cells.
The only tests are within-stratum period contrasts (PR CIs, AAPC vs zero), which rule 6 says make no entry; the across-group claims rest on values set side by side.
